text.tspan: Phase by phase: each is asked for through the Broker, its completion comes back the same way,
and a phase past its timeout has its manager stopped so that the next can begin.
A registration asked for now is refused ("Broker is shutting down").
The pressure manager ends with the drain. A client finds its connection gone,
and its facade keeps its outbox and tries again until a broker is back.
[the token is not the one it started with (compared in constant time)]

svg.text: PrepareForShutdown: from now each publish is refused for now,
which a client keeps for the broker that comes back
each answered publish lowers the count, and a session ends when it is done
each topic pumps what waits, ignoring any hold,
each subscriber told and stopped, and what it holds is not flushed
stop each, and its connection closes
